inputs.acceptance_evidence: New model/party.py module with 8 dataclasses (Country, PostalAddress, PartyIdentification, PartyName, Contact, TaxScheme, PartyTaxScheme, Party) and matching *_of() projectors, each field grounded directly in the pinned XSD's PartyType/AddressType/CountryType/PartyIdentificationType/PartyNameType/ContactType/TaxSchemeType/PartyTaxSchemeType complexTypes read straight from the ZIP. 19 new tests prove every projector's positive, absent, and multi-value cases plus a full document round trip through AccountingSupplierParty/Party.
inputs.regression_tier: full ubl package suite (tests/python/ubl) plus 6-format regression

execution_steps: 1. Grepped the whole ubl model package for 'class Party' and 'class PostalAddress' -- zero hits, confirming both are genuinely unmodeled, not stale citations.

2. Extracted xsd/common/UBL-CommonAggregateComponents-2.3.xsd directly from the pinned OASIS UBL 2.3 release ZIP (.local/format-contracts/acquired/ubl/src-ubl-002.bin) and read PartyType, AddressType, CountryType, PartyIdentificationType, PartyNameType, ContactType, TaxSchemeType, and PartyTaxSchemeType directly -- every field name, cardinality, and nesting relationship in the new module is sourced from this read, not memory or an incomplete SAL fact.

3. Scoped deliberately to leaf-level fields matching this codebase's existing pattern (e.g. charges.FinancialAccount from event 193): PostalAddress models the 4 sub-elements the contract itself names plus the Country it references (not the XSD type's full ~28 optional fields); PartyTaxScheme's nested RegistrationAddress (itself another PostalAddress) is deliberately not modeled, documented explicitly in the module's own docstring, not silently narrowed.

4. Wrote model/party.py mirroring the exact code style of charges.py/aggregates.py (frozen dataclasses, _require for genuinely-required XSD fields, find()/find_all()-based projectors, optional-returns-None pattern for optional aggregates). Wired all 16 new names through model/__init__.py and the top-level package __init__.py.

5. Ran an interactive probe against a full document (AccountingSupplierParty/Party with all 5 named child kinds populated) before writing any test -- every field, the empty-party case, party_of(None), and a full round trip all worked correctly on the first attempt.

6. Wrote 19 new tests. Ran ruff (clean) and the full ubl suite (757 passed, was 738, +19) before writing any evidence claim. Ran the full 6-format regression (3020 passed, was 3001, +19; same 4 pre-existing unrelated safetensors interop failures, 2 skipped) confirming zero cross-format regression.
tests_run: .venv/Scripts/pytest tests/python/ipynb tests/python/ora tests/python/nrrd tests/python/xliff tests/python/safetensors tests/python/ubl -q -- 3020 passed, 2 skipped, 4 preexisting unrelated safetensors interop failures, was 3001 passed

evidence.oracle: Verified against the pinned OASIS UBL 2.3 release package's own vendored XSD schema (extracted directly from the ZIP, not a SAL-fact paraphrase or memory) -- higher-confidence than typical SELF-CONSISTENT evidence, though still not cross-checked against an independent reference UBL implementation, per GAP-008.
